      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "Do not use both assert and doNotOptimizeAway",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "applied by author in update",
      "author_replies": [

      ],
      "other_replies": [],

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Disk benchmarks might inadvertently remain in memory/page cache, failing to measure disk performance",
      "quote": "these are likely small, so even if they're not in memory, the OS will likely make sure they're still actually in memory...",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "l0rinc accepted explanation and asked to resolve",

      "other_replies": [],

      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Whether the two conditions checking FindSpender results are identical",

      "kind": "approach",

      "status": "fixed",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4441247812",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Move chainstate flush into BenchIndexSync() rather than ExtendChainWithSpends()",
      "quote": "Could we move the chainstate flush into `BenchIndexSync()`? `BaseIndex::Commit()` needs it, while chain construction and lookup-only setup do not.",
      "clears_with": "change",

      "status_note": "applied by author using reviewer's patch",

      ],

      "status_by_id": "c:6643469612",
      "status_by_quote": "I applied all of your suggestions and added you as a co-author, since I used your patches exactly as you wrote them."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4441253733",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Stop temporary indexes with StopIndex() to drain queued validation callbacks",
      "quote": "Could we stop each temporary index with the existing `StopIndex()` helper? It drains queued validation callbacks before unregistering the index",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "applied by author using reviewer's patch",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6643469612"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6643469612",
      "status_by_quote": "I applied all of your suggestions and added you as a co-author, since I used your patches exactly as you wrote them."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4441262828",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Share the lookup index lifecycle across lookup benchmarks to prevent drift",
      "quote": "The two lookup benchmarks have the same setup, synced check, and shutdown sequence, and keeping it beside the timed loop makes them harder to drift.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "applied by author using reviewer's patch",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6643469612"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6643469612",
      "status_by_quote": "I applied all of your suggestions and added you as a co-author, since I used your patches exactly as you wrote them."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4441275858",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Return constructed blocks from ExtendChainWithSpends() instead of re-reading them from disk under cs_main",
      "quote": "The current helpers re-read all 51 blocks from disk while holding `cs_main`, even though the benchmark just built those blocks.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "applied by author using reviewer's patch",

        "c:6643469612"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6643469612",
      "status_by_quote": "I applied all of your suggestions and added you as a co-author, since I used your patches exactly as you wrote them."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:4791093422",
